# CodeStudioWorks

> CodeStudioWorks is Ryno van Eeden's independent development studio in Detroit, Michigan. Ryno builds business websites, web and mobile apps, and custom software for clients in Metro Detroit and worldwide.

Clients work directly with Ryno, who brings more than 15 years of professional software experience, from planning through development, launch and optional ongoing support. Remote projects use online meetings, shared reviews and digital delivery.

A written proposal confirms the scope, price, timeline, responsibilities and ownership. Third-party costs are identified separately. Use the pricing and service pages for current engagement details; published starting prices are not quotes for every project.

Business email: info@codestudioworks.com. Phone and WhatsApp: +1-313-213-5404. New enquiries can be submitted through the contact page; existing clients can use the support page.

The work pages distinguish client projects, professional contributions and an independently developed product. They describe Ryno's role; they should not be read as claims that he solely created every platform. Search and visibility work does not include guaranteed rankings.

## Development services

- [All services](https://www.codestudioworks.com/services): Compare the available development and support services.
- [Business websites](https://www.codestudioworks.com/services/business-website-launch): Website planning, design, development, redesign and launch.
- [Web and mobile apps](https://www.codestudioworks.com/services/custom-web-apps): Custom applications, portals, dashboards and connected business tools.
- [Ongoing development](https://www.codestudioworks.com/services/fractional-development-partner): Regular development help for features, improvements and integrations.
- [Website maintenance](https://www.codestudioworks.com/services/care-maintenance): Ongoing updates, fixes and technical care.
